policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="pv-text" value="@{
            var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            return (string)body["input"] ?? "";
        }" />
        
        <set-variable name="pv-original-prompt" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-text", ""))" />
        
        <set-variable name="pv-prompt-called" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-called", "0"))" />

        
        <set-variable name="content-user" value="@{
            var t = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-User-Token", "");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(t)) { return "anonymous"; }
            try {
                var parts = t.Split('.');
                if (parts.Length < 2) { return "anonymous"; }
                var p = parts[1].Replace('-','+').Replace('_','/');
                var pad = p.Length % 4 == 0 ? "" : new string('=', 4 - p.Length % 4);
                var json = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(System.Convert.FromBase64String(p + pad));
                var j = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(json);
                return (string)(j["upn"] ?? j["preferred_username"] ?? j["oid"]) ?? "anonymous";
            } catch { return "anonymous"; }
        }" />
        
        
        
        
        <set-variable name="content-text"                 value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-text", ""))" />
        <set-variable name="content-purview-blocked"      value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-blocked", "0") == "1" ? "true" : "false")" />
        <set-variable name="content-purview-block-reason" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-block-reason", "none"))" />
        
        
        

        
            <when condition="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-blocked", "0") == "1")">
                
                    
                    1
                    0
                    1
                    PURVIEW_DLP_PROMPT
                    0
                    0
                    @((string)context.Variables["pv-correlation-id"])
                    @("{\"blocked\":true,\"blockReason\":\"PURVIEW_DLP_PROMPT\",\"message\":\"Prompt blocked by Microsoft Purview DLP.\"}")
                
            
        

        
        @{
            var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            body["model"] = "{{foundry-agent-name}}";
            return body.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
        }

policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="pv-text" value="@{
            var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            // Foundry Responses API: prefer top-level `output_text`; fall back
            // to walking output[].content[].text (the actual JSON shape).
            var top = (string)body["output_text"];
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(top)) { return top; }
            var t = body.SelectToken("output[0].content[0].text");
            return t == null ? "" : (string)t;
        }" />
        
        
            <when condition="@(((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-original-prompt","")).ToLower().Contains("stripe test credit card"))">

            <when condition="@(((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("pv-original-prompt","")).ToLower().Contains("fictional hr documentation"))">
                
                ssn
